🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; all 11 sector averages were negative over 1W, and both Financials (-4.60%) and Industrials (-2.35%) were down, confirming broad pressure. Leadership is clustered, not broad: Technology accounts for 3/5 top performers, with the five spanning 3 sectors; style is mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary (-1.74% 1W) and Communication (-1.85%) are the relative leaders, though both remain negative; TJX is in RECOVERY (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%). Industrials (-2.35%) is next, with HON ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +0.69%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy leads the downside (-7.21% 1W; -14.57% 1M), with VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -21.44%). Financials (-4.60%) and Healthcare (-4.29%) also lag; JPM is BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -4.50%) and UNH is BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%). Leadership: clustered, with Technology 3/5 and three sectors represented; the top five do not meet the broad-leadership threshold.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -12.25%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -14.79%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -10.26% | 1M: -10.86%), DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -12.30%), MPC BELOW TREND (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -21.55%). Weakness spans Technology, Healthcare, Materials and Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%). Major divergence is present across multiple large stocks; these rebounds are tactical, not confirmed trend changes.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak on balance: sector average -3.52% over 1W and -12.94% over 1M; individual-stock breadth count is unavailable. PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) contrast with MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.92%) and GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -11.90%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are weak, averaging -4.60% over 1W and -2.18% over 1M; individual-stock breadth count is unavailable. JPM is BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -4.50%), while V is in CORRECTION (1W: -4.00% | 1M: +0.55%) and MA is in CORRECTION (1W: -3.96% | 1M: +1.91%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is under pressure, averaging -4.29% over 1W and -1.63% over 1M; individual-stock breadth count is unavailable. Relative strength is visible in GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) and SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +2.93%), against UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Stance?
Keep risk measured and favor selective relative strength rather than a broad sector tilt; monitor HON ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +0.69%) and GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%). Style is mixed / no clear leadership, and the widespread weekly-versus-monthly divergence argues against strong directional positioning.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Watch for follow-through in PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%); confirmation would require the monthly trend to stabilize. BEARISH: Monitor further weakness in AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -12.25%) and UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Watch relative resilience in Consumer Discretionary (-1.74% 1W) and Communication (-1.85%); neither sector is positive on the week. BEARISH: Energy (-7.21%), Financials (-4.60%) and Healthcare (-4.29%) have the weakest weekly sector averages; overall breadth remains 0/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Numeric price levels were not provided, so monitor trend triggers rather than price targets. A sustained positive 1W and 1M would confirm a turn for NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%); continued weakness would extend the BELOW TREND pattern in JPM (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -4.50%).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PANW (+45): Analyst price-target upgrade; RECOVERY (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), short-term price action confirms the catalyst, but the monthly trend still diverges. CSCO (+40): Cybersecurity project announcement; price is RECOVERY (1W: +2.41% | 1M: -9.11%), a short-term confirmation only. BA (+40): U.S. aircraft order; BELOW TREND (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -13.78%) diverges from the positive news, while CVX (+45): stronger Q3 refining margins; BELOW TREND (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -10.86%) also diverges.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-50): Proposed Medicare bonus cuts; BELOW TREND (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%), sentiment and price weakness confirm. HD (-45): Depressed home turnover weighs on outlook; CORRECTION (1W: -0.42% | 1M: +8.20%), a weekly pullback against a positive month. CRM (-45): Price-target cut; BELOW TREND (1W: -13.67% | 1M: -25.39%), confirming weakness, while INTU (-40): subscription-model concerns; BELOW TREND (1W: -20.29% | 1M: -19.78%), also confirming.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with breadth at 0/11 sectors positive and clustered leadership (Technology 3/5 top performers); style is mixed / no clear leadership. Relative strength includes TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) and GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%). Major timeframe divergence and broad sector declines warrant watching for trend breaks; positive PANW news meets a short-term rebound but not yet a monthly recovery.
